graph_domains.name: Waste Acceptance & Profile Governance
graph_domains.note: All five expected sources are connected; the approvals, facility and billing datasets are declared by dictionaries, and permits, modifications, profiles and lab reports are in the Drive corpus.
graph_domains.unmet_note: No profile, approval or permit source connected.

graph_domains.name: Permit & Inspection Readiness
graph_domains.note: Permit versions, waste analysis plans and discrepancy clocks resolve. No inspection history or agency correspondence is connected, so readiness for an inspection visit is never scored.
graph_domains.unmet_note: No permit register or discrepancy source connected.

graph_domains.name: Facility Capacity & Throughput
graph_domains.note: Receipts, injection logs, tank inventory and fuel shipments are connected; transport schedules are not, so gate congestion and routing are never tested.
graph_domains.unmet_note: No receiving or operations source connected.

graph_domains.name: Predictive Profile Risk
graph_domains.note: Eighteen months of fingerprints, and process changes that arrive by email rather than as records, cannot support a model validated out of time.
graph_domains.unmet_note: No long fingerprint history or recorded process changes connected.

graph_use_case_templates.name: Waste Acceptance & Profile Governance
graph_use_case_templates.description: One model over profiles, approvals, permits, receipts, lab results and customer systems, so an acceptance question resolves once, with the permit version and the regulatory clock stated.

graph_metrics.name: Active approval
graph_metrics.definition: Approval with status Active, not expired, resting on the latest certified profile version. State the facility and as-of date; a suspended approval is not active. Owner: Priya Raman.

graph_metrics.name: Re-certification overdue
graph_metrics.definition: Active approval whose profile re-certification date is before the as-of date. Report loads received since the due date separately; approvals without a date are named, not assumed current. Owner: Priya Raman.

graph_metrics.name: Approval cycle time
graph_metrics.definition: Days from complete profile submission to approval decision. Define complete; report time waiting on the generator separately. Owner: Priya Raman.

graph_metrics.name: Permit-fit exception
graph_metrics.definition: Active approval listing a waste code not authorized for its facility and unit in the permit version effective on the as-of date. The permit document is the authority; show the modification that caused it. Owner: Jordan Ellis.

graph_metrics.name: Significant quantity discrepancy
graph_metrics.definition: Bulk: received differs from manifested by more than 10 percent by weight. Batch: any difference in piece count. 40 CFR 264.72 definition; convert units with the declared density before comparing. Owner: Luis Ortega.

graph_metrics.name: Discrepancy age
graph_metrics.definition: Days from receipt to reconciliation, or to the as-of date if open. Compare with the 20-day window; a system status alone is not reconciliation. Owner: Luis Ortega.

graph_metrics.name: Load conformance rate
graph_metrics.definition: Loads whose fingerprint results fall within approved tolerances divided by loads tested. State the parameters and the population tested; untested loads are not conforming. Owner: Ahmed Siddiqui.

graph_metrics.name: Rejection rate
graph_metrics.definition: Rejected loads divided by loads received, by facility, customer or profile. Separate full and partial rejections. Owner: Luis Ortega.

graph_metrics.name: Volume received
graph_metrics.definition: Sum of measured net quantity at the gate, in one declared unit. Exclude onward shipments within the network to avoid double counting. Owner: Jordan Ellis.

graph_metrics.name: Surcharge support rate
graph_metrics.definition: Surcharges with a linked fingerprint result and contract clause divided by all surcharges. A clause without a result, or a result without a clause, is unsupported. Owner: Tasha Greene.

graph_metrics.name: Unresolved generator identities
graph_metrics.definition: Customer accounts with a proposed but unreviewed generator match. Show the volume and revenue they carry. Owner: Ray Delacroix.

graph_metrics.name: Certificate coverage
graph_metrics.definition: Loads with an unbroken chain from receipt to disposal, including onward shipments, divided by loads requested. A consolidation without an onward link breaks the chain; name the load and the owner. Owner: Jordan Ellis.
